title: The Persuasion Bazaar
learning_focus: Persuasive text, propaganda techniques, author point of view, target audience, logic, tone, and visual influence.
story_premise: Vendors compete to attract visitors using slogans, testimonials, bandwagon claims, fear, half-truths, and card stacking. The Pathfinder becomes the bazaar’s media reviewer.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Persuasive text, propaganda techniques, author point of view, target audience, logic, tone, and visual influence.

areas.story: Identify glittering generalities and labels. Evaluate whether a testimonial is relevant evidence.
